verdict.rationale: PayPal's REST API docs explicitly document webhook subscriptions: HTTPS callbacks to a merchant endpoint for event types, with a documented setup flow to subscribe a listening URL for an app (paypal-docs-9, paypal-docs-28). This is a standard, well-documented developer capability usable by any programmatic/AI-native integration built on PayPal's APIs. Missing for 10: no explicit mention of webhook subscription being exposed as an agent-toolkit/MCP tool for natural-language subscription management, and no independent/hands-on corroboration beyond first-party docs.
